en.name: CSS Gradient Generator
en.short: Create linear, radial and conic gradients with several color stops.
en.title: CSS gradient generator: linear, radial and conic
en.description: Create CSS gradients visually: linear, radial and conic, repeating or not, with as many color stops as you want and live preview. Paste an existing gradient to edit it and copy the CSS. 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Add color stops, move them and pick the angle: the CSS updates as you go.
